revoke((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint64,ui.notice: Processes an attestation revocation and verifies if it can be revoked.

schemaAdmin().notice: The only address that may call `setSchemas` (one shot; see `schemasSet`).

schemasSet().notice: Whether the schema allowlist has been set (it can only ever be set once).

setSchemas(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Set the schema allowlist. Callable exactly once, only by `schemaAdmin`. Until this         is called every attestation reverts, so no edge with an untrusted kind tag can ever         enter the accumulator.

version().notice: Returns the full semver contract version.
